rule: Each case runs on a freshly dropped database: setup commands in order, then the measured command. Every command is canonical Extended JSON v2; '$C' was already replaced by the case's own collection. Commands are written from the public documentation pages linked in 'docs' (paraphrased into commands, no text copied); no MongoDB test file was read for this corpus.

cases.name: insertMany unordered reports a per-item duplicate key and keeps the rest
insertMany ordered stops at the first duplicate key
inserted document round-trips with key order and numeric types intact
nested documents keep their key order on round trip (hashed-payload case)
replaceOne with upsert inserts when absent
replaceOne with upsert replaces the whole document when present
state after a replace has no fields from the old document
find by _id with limit 1
find by _id that does not exist returns an empty exhausted batch
_id of a different numeric type matches by value
$eq on a top-level string field
anchored $regex prefix match
$gte and $lte on a date range
$eq on owner plus prefix on namespace
projection excludes the value field
$eq on a nested field with dot notation
null matches a null field and a missing field
$exists false on a nested path
cross-type numeric equality on a nested field
$in over an array field matches any element
$all requires every element
scalar equality matches an array element
$size zero matches the empty array
sort descending by date with limit
skip and limit page through a sorted set
compound sort on a nested field then _id
count with a filter
batchSize leaves a cursor open, getMore drains it
sort over mixed types follows the BSON comparison order
$set on a nested path
state after $set creates missing intermediate documents
$set through a null intermediate is an error
$set appends a new field at the end of the document
$inc on an int32 counter
$inc result type: int32 plus int64 becomes int64
$inc on a missing field creates it
$inc on a string is an error
$addToSet adds a new member
$addToSet with an existing member reports no modification
$addToSet with $each
$push appends
$pull removes every match
compare-and-set succeeds when the version matches and returns the new document
compare-and-set fails cleanly when the version is stale
compare-and-set on a nested field returns the old document by default
findAndModify with upsert and new returns the inserted document
$group count per owner, sorted
$match then $count
$group with $max on a date and $sum on a nested int
$group on a namespace prefix with $substrCP
$facet with two branches
$lookup joins on a key within the same collection
create a compound index and list it
a unique compound index rejects a duplicate
hint forces a named index and the answer is unchanged
a partial unique index ignores documents outside its filter
a partial unique index rejects a duplicate inside its filter
$text search over a text index
a TTL index is accepted and listed with its expiry
an unknown query operator is an error
a malformed sort specification is an error
